boundary.toc_body_discrepancy: The table of contents lists 财帛宫 at p68; direct inspection of the body shows P04 Pojun text on p68 and the 财帛宫 body heading on p69. Preserve the discrepancy; do not silently renumber or exclude p68.
boundary.candidate_batch_ends_mid_page_53_after: Chen-Xu Ziwei-Tianxiang passage; remaining p53 Ziwei-Qisha / general Ziwei and Tianji opening are reserved for CH02-101…200.

source_anchors.description: P04 scope: relations with one's own children, child personality/count, and later-generation interpersonal relations; the P04 heading begins partway down p51.
Definition of later generation and the boundary example distinguishing ordinary shop workers (P08) from a personally cultivated right-hand assistant who can independently manage work (P04).
Modern child-count interpretation is deemphasized; the older method is retained by the source as a way to consider presence and breadth of junior support.
Methodological ordering: judge the natal P04 palace first, then consult the three-direction/four-cardinal context.
Distinction between good/poor primary-star configurations, auxiliary stars, malefics, traditional number claims, status assessment, and whether a configuration is classified as affliction.
Traditional south/north-star and day/night birth claims. CH01-022 combines separate sex-ratio and affliction/separation branches and must be split.
Transfer of the older P04 method to later-generation relations; auxiliary single-star/two-layer claims and the source's modern two-marriage context.
Distinguish Lu Cun from Hua Lu in child-wealth interpretation; Fire/Bell or Tianma-Lu Cun configurations are described in relation to distance from parents.
Ziwei in Zi/Wu: personality, isolation, status, support, leadership, rebellion/control, intelligence, traditional sex/count claims, and a response-period phrase.
Ziwei-with-malefic response-period conditions. The source names a response period but does not specify YEAR or DECADE.
Ziwei-Pojun in Chou/Wei: traditional count/sex/twins claims, intelligence/support outcomes, and a rebellion pattern.
Ziwei-Pojun malefic/rebellion claims and transit-response conditions; the source does not identify the time layer for '行至' / '克应之期'.

Ziwei-Tianfu in Yin/Shen: traditional counts, auxiliary-star alternatives, spouse-palace interpretation, wealth and junior-support claims; the adversity response period explicitly allows major period or year.
Ziwei-Tianfu empty-vault and Ziwei-Tanlang patterns: resource dependence, relationship, arrogance, and modifiers that explicitly inherit the Ziwei-Tianfu interpretation.
Chen/Xu Ziwei-Tianxiang: weakness, junior usefulness, mobility, intelligence, a case-only moralized risk, and career assistance. CH01 ends mid-page after this passage.

gap_register.unresolved: Response period is stated but YEAR/DECADE scope is not specified; legacy YEAR labels are not accepted.
The source uses a moving '行至…克应之期' condition without identifying YEAR or DECADE.
The source says the Life Palace '行至' a configuration; legacy NATAL classification is unsupported and the moving time layer is unspecified.
